description: Create an alert on a stat: webhook fires when the condition is met (above/below threshold, % change, heartbeat/missing data, sustained). Deliveries retry with backoff and carry a stable idempotency_key so receivers can dedup. The stat is referenced by NAME; it must already exist.

condition_type.description: above/below: value crosses threshold. pct_change: % move over window_minutes. heartbeat/missing_data: no data for window_minutes. sustained: above threshold for consecutive evaluations.

stat.description: Name of the stat to alert on (as shown by list_stats).

webhook_url.description: Public HTTPS receiver for the alert payload (private/internal targets are refused). Email delivery is coming soon — webhook/Slack only for now.

window_minutes.description: Staleness window for heartbeat/missing_data, lookback for pct_change (minutes).

name: create_alert
